set.body: New test-only warm measurement wrapper at frozen source 327eda. One documented warmup plus five same-process measured repetitions; voxels hard-limited to 256. Reuses ConditionC0QualificationHarness.runQualified unchanged. No scientific source changes, no full 100k execution, and no performance qualification.
set.title: PHRF-21: bounded same-process C0 warm measurement wrapper
